written_before: any result of state-dependent sizing. Known before: the 88-cell fixed-size grid (best P4 12/4 Topstep 50K +$74-132, luck negative everywhere) and JJ Simon's claims (brain/sources/practitioner_leads/jj_simon_prop_firm_method_2026-10-28.md).
questions: Q1: does SC-FUT-0005 with size set from the account's cushion beat the fixed P4 play and pass the gate out of sample?
Q2 (JJ's claim): does a zero-edge strategy (the matched random-direction control) become positive net cash with the best state-dependent size?
Q3: a $500 live account, 1 MNQ: chance of +10% ($50) before the broker liquidates it, and the chance of losing it over a year.

strategy.luck: the trial's matched random-direction control, one draw per day, identical sizing

firms: brain/_system/prop/firms/topstep_50k_standard.json (all payout-path variants; includes the $29/mo API fee)
brain/_system/prop/firms/tradeify_growth_50k.json (only if a NinjaTrader route is built; Tradeify forbids the same bot at two firms)

sizing_rule.formula: contracts today = clamp(floor(a x cushion / R), 1, the firm's max micros for the phase); cushion = equity - loss floor at the open (from the simulator state)
sizing_rule.R_source: 1% worst day at 1 MNQ (SC-FUT-0005 independent review); a risk number, not tuned on profit
sizing_rule.other: firm soft daily loss as before; stop at the eval target; no profit stops; the optional firm DLL taken

split.why: alternating years so both halves hold calm and volatile years; resampling stays inside the half

selection.Q1: on train, per firm variant, the (a_eval, a_funded) with the highest strategy mean net cash
selection.Q2: on train, per firm variant, the (a_eval, a_funded) with the highest LUCK mean net cash (selected for luck on its own)
selection.baseline: fixed P4 (12 / 4) re-run on the test half for comparison

gates_on_test.Q1: mean net cash lower 90% bound > $0 AND (net - luck) lower 90% bound > $0; a pass is a candidate and needs a confirmation run (fresh seed, outer 200, lowest resample) per the grid addendum
gates_on_test.Q2: zero-edge claim supported if the luck-selected policy's luck mean net cash lower 90% bound > $0; any such result is first treated as a possible simulator or rules error

live_500.liquidation: broker flattens when intraday equity falls to $50 (day-margin floor assumption); loss = $450 + 2 ticks
live_500.costs: L3 (Topstep fees + 4 ticks), close to retail micro commissions

honesty: prop trials: 16 train cells x 2 selections share runs; test cells counted one each; all logged to prop_trials.jsonl with kind state_sizing
